name: Inkling 2 Mini
traits: Looped transformer that runs its middle layers three times for every token.
Mixture-of-Experts model with 26.4B total parameters, 3.4B active.
Trained and deployed natively in NVFP4, with the last four layers in MXFP8.

advice.value: inference where speed is paramount, or running on local hardware
set limits on output tokens and agent turns

resistance: Refuses many malicious side tasks in agentic tests
art_briefs: A slender tide giantess wades a shallow violet sea at dawn, her body carved from translucent sea glass with a tide circling inside her chest three times. On one open palm she carries a tiny lit harbor town, its boats moored; with the other hand she gently turns away a dark iron ship. Palette: violet, seafoam, coral pink, pale gold. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A regal quicksilver stag races a spiral road that winds three times around a desert mesa, leaping toward open sky. Its antlers are fine copper wire strung with tiny glowing beads, a small brass pack on its back for the long road. Three faint afterimages trace each loop; a distant lighthouse waits ahead. Palette: tangerine, chrome silver, deep teal, dusk magenta. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A tall, lean courier in a silver pressure suit strides along a spiral causeway that loops three times around a red mesa, a small glowing core cradled against her chest, cape streaming behind her. Far below, a quiet desert city lights up at dusk; ahead, the road climbs toward a distant beacon tower. Palette of tangerine, deep violet, and polished chrome. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A great snow leopard sculpted of living jade stands on a moonlit ridge, three thin rings of pale light circling its head like slow halos. Before it, a hooded stranger offers a black dagger; the leopard turns its proud head away, guarding a small domed observatory glowing behind it. Palette of teal, cream, and soft magenta under a starfield. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A towering bronze-skinned titaness strides the third lap of a spiral road wound around a colossal mountain, a glowing ember-lamp cradled against her chest. Her footprints from the earlier laps still smoke on the terraces below, and dawn breaks over a vast canyon plain. Palette of burnt orange, ochre, and deep violet. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A serene giant of pale blue crystal crosses a frozen sea toward a distant beacon. Without breaking stride, he raises one open palm to turn aside a black blade offered by shadowy hands reaching from the storm clouds, while the ice cracks in a long trail behind him. Palette of glacier blue, silver, and magenta dusk. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A slender giant of living quicksilver stands waist-deep in a still black lake at dusk, compact and composed, her surface folding back into itself in three slow rings around her chest. Her face is calm, watchful, gaze fixed on a far horizon. Cold rim light traces her shoulders. Palette: graphite, chrome silver, deep teal, one thin line of violet sky. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A small, dense titan of dark volcanic glass sits upright on a basalt ledge above a night desert, broad-shouldered and patient, hands resting on its knees. Thin seams of ember light pulse beneath its skin, steady and banked, never flaring. A low amber moon lights one side of its face. Palette: obsidian, indigo, banked amber, ash grey. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.
